response.overview: Try your best to make goodness attractive. That's one of the toughest assignments you'll ever be given," said Fred Rogers.  This award-winning documentary about Fred Rogers and the Mister Rogers' Neighborhood program includes interviews with Joanne Rogers, David Newell, Hedda Sharapan, Margy Whitmer and Maxwell King.  (Directed by Lance Wilhelm; Produced by Adina Munin & Jean Daniher)
response.title: Our Assignment from Fred Rogers
